_: The engage deck's slide library: the master slides a rep can put after the prospect's opening slides. One id space (sid): Short Pack slides keep their bare ids (the first engage build stored them that way), the others carry their deck as a prefix. Deck order here is the order they take in a generated deck. Copies of this file: the app's src/lib/engage-library.json (Create pane + API) and workers/engage/engage-library.json (worker + writer); keep them identical. `version` is appended to every thumbnail URL (?v=) so a browser that once cached a 404 for a thumbnail fetches the new file; bump it when the thumbnails are recaptured. The entries below are sample data (original slide list removed).
